title: Orbit Diagnostics v. District Health Authority

brief.about: The appeal is against suspension of the appellant's registration for three months for incomplete record of procedures. Issue notice.
brief.last: Reply is filed. The appellant seeks time for rejoinder. Interim order to continue.
brief.today: Listed for rejoinder and final arguments.

orders.summary: The appeal is against suspension of the appellant's registration for three months for incomplete record of procedures. Issue notice. Suspension is stayed till the next date.
directions: Suspension is stayed till the next date.
